text:
emma_support: FYI — AcmeTravel reported that after the model promotion earlier today Japanese translation outputs are coming back in romaji / mixed English instead of native Japanese. Customer pasted a snippet: 

acme_cust: Request: 'フライトはありますか？'
acme_cust: Response (today): 'Furaito wa arimasu ka? We have flights available.'

emma_support: They say this started ~10:20 UTC after the 'rbw-serve-3.2' rollout. Customer is on hosted us-west1, sending model=redwood-alpha-3.2 in headers. :eyes:

raj_engineer: Thanks Emma. Do we have the deployment audit for 3.2? Lia, any canary->prod promotion timestamps?

lia_ops: infra-bot posted the promotion at 1955000600 (canary->prod). We promoted stable canary to all customers at 03:18 UTC. No other infra changes noted.

mike_eng_ml: Short note — romaji/latin script suggests tokenizer or detokenization change, or a fallback to an English-anchored subtokenizer. Can you paste the raw request (headers + body) and a full response payload (including token array) so we can inspect?

emma_support: Pasting sanitized curl we used to repro:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \n  -H 'Region: us-west1' \n  -H 'Model: redwood-alpha-3.2' \n  -d '{"input":"フライトはありますか？", "max_tokens":40, "lang":"ja"}'
```
Response body (sanitized):
```
{"id":"resp_123","model":"redwood-alpha-3.2","output":"Furaito wa arimasu ka? We have flights available.","tokens":["Fur","aito"," wa"," arimasu"," ka","?"," We"," have"," flights"," available","."]}
```

emma_support: Customer also attached a second example where Chinese characters got returned as pinyin. They are understandably upset.

raj_engineer: OK that's very telling — tokens include ascii chunks and no kanji/katakana tokens. Looks like the tokenizer mapping for CJK was replaced or a wrong vocabulary file loaded. I'll pull the model artifacts for 3.2 and diff tokenizers.

mike_eng_ml: Can we confirm whether 3.2 introduced a new tokenizer merge file or used a different sentencepiece/vocab? Also check whether quantization conversion step accidentally swapped vocab indexes.

lia_ops: Patch notes for 3.2 mention "vocab normalization fixes" — after double-check: we swapped to vocab_v2 to address a Latin punctuation edge-case. It appears that change was applied to all repacked variants. Rolling back is an option but needs approval.

emma_support: Customer wants ETA. Can we do a temporary routing to 3.1 for this tenant until root cause is fixed?

raj_engineer: We can add a routing rule for that org id. Need the org id — Emma, can you DM me the account id? I can push a per-tenant override to route to redwood-alpha-3.1-stable.

mike_eng_ml: In parallel I'll run a local reproduce: load redwood-alpha-3.2 artifact, dump tokenizer.vocab and compare encoding for 'フライトはありますか？' vs 3.1. If it's vocab index mismatch we'll likely revert vocab_v2 or re-run conversion.

lia_ops: I'll hold the global rollback until we confirm blast radius. Suggest per-tenant override as mitigation.

infra-bot: deployment: promoted redwood-alpha-3.2 -> prod @ 1955000600 by release-engineering (canary was healthy).

emma_support: Sent DM with account id. Also told customer we're investigating and offered a temporary routing if they'd like immediate mitigation.

raj_engineer: Got account id, creating override now. ETA ~8 minutes to propagate. Will post back when routing is live.

mike_eng_ml: Quick note: include a deterministic example (raw token ids) in your reproduction output. That will make it clear whether tokenizer or model weights produced the romanization. Ask customer to include the response token ids if they can.

emma_support: Will request token ids and inform them of the temporary route. Thanks all — I'll update thread when customer responds or when routing is live. :thumbsup:

lia_ops: Action items: (1) raj to push per-tenant routing to 3.1 (in progress), (2) mike to diff tokenizer artifacts and run encoding checks, (3) lia to evaluate whether a global rollback is needed once root cause confirmed.

raj_engineer: Override pushed; routing for AcmeTravel -> redwood-alpha-3.1-stable active @ 1955002620. Please verify with customer.

emma_support: Pinged customer to confirm; they reported back "initial check looks normal now, thanks". Closing temporary mitigation once backend confirmers give green.

mike_eng_ml: Found the root cause: vocab_v2 accidentally used latin-anchored merges for CJK due to an earlier conversion script bug. We'll prepare a fixed vocab_v2b and test. Plan: (a) hotfix vocab file and rerun packaging for 3.2, (b) test canary with multilingual testset, (c) promote. Est. timeline 4–6 hours to fully validate.

emma_support: Noted; communicated timeline to customer. I'll keep them updated.

lia_ops: Marking incident as P2 for now (customer-visible regression). Posting follow-up in incidents channel after root cause fix.

emma_support: Thanks everyone. I'll add the customer's sample prompts to our regression suite so we catch this in future releases.
